# Fortify on Demand fixture provenance

These files are synthetic, redacted fixtures shaped from the Fortify on Demand Web API v3 OpenAPI document at `https://api.ams.fortify.com/swagger/docs/v3`, retrieved on 2026-11-10.

They contain no tenant identifiers, credentials, customer names, or downloaded report content. Identifiers and timestamps are deterministic test values. The fixture set covers paginated vulnerabilities, scans, data-export jobs, and issue details used by offline mapping and replay tests.
